servicesCatalog.title: Services and plans
servicesCatalog.subtitle: Turnkey solutions with prices in Colombian pesos.

hero.title: Custom software or monthly subscription
hero.subtitle: Choose how you want to work with us: we deliver your own software or you use our platform as a service.

servicesIntro.title: Services — custom development
servicesIntro.body: We build fully custom software for your company. We hand over the source code, documentation and access. The software is yours — host it anywhere. APIs (OpenAI, etc.) and infrastructure are billed directly by their providers.

plansIntro.title: Plans — software as a service
plansIntro.body: Use our production-ready solutions with a monthly fee. We take care of hosting, maintenance, updates and scaling. Usage-based add-ons (LLMs, WhatsApp, maps) are billed directly by their providers.

service.ownership: You own the source code when we are done

plan.noOwnership: Software hosted by us — you use it, we keep it running

maintenance.label: Monthly maintenance
maintenance.noticeBody: Maintenance is independent of setup and billed monthly (or annually with a discount).

totalCost.explanation: Year 1 includes setup. Maintenance is billed from month 1.

modal.title: Plans and pricing
modal.costsNote: These costs are paid by the client directly to the provider (OpenAI, AWS, Twilio, etc.). We build, integrate and maintain the system, but we do not bill APIs or infrastructure.
modal.costsNoteSaas: Your plan includes hosting, database and monitoring. Usage-based add-ons (LLMs, WhatsApp, maps, etc.) are paid directly to the provider based on real usage.
modal.ownershipServiceBody: You own 100% of the source code when the project ends. Host it wherever you want — you do not depend on us.
modal.ownershipPlanBody: You use the platform as a service: we host, monitor and update it. You do not receive source code; cancel anytime.

supportSLA.24-48h email: Email in business hours, 24-48h business response
supportSLA.4h business: Email + WhatsApp in business hours, 4h business response
supportSLA.1h business: Email + chat + phone in business hours, 1h business response
supportSLA.priority-1h: Priority support in Colombian business hours, 1h business SLA for critical incidents

servicesCatalog.noResults: We did not find results for your search.
servicesCatalog.ctaTitle: Not sure which one to pick?
servicesCatalog.ctaBody: Talk to us — we will help you decide whether to own the software or use our SaaS.

support.sla24h: Email in business hours, max 24h business response
support.sla4h: Email + WhatsApp in business hours, max 4h business response
support.sla1h: Priority support in business hours, 1h business SLA for critical incidents
support.label: Support

servicesCatalog.infraNote: Automated monitoring and auto-scaling configured from day one. Infrastructure costs (AWS/GCP/Vercel/Datadog) and third-party API costs (OpenAI, Twilio, Stripe) are billed by the provider directly to the customer — we do not mark them up.

customNotice.title: Can't find what you need?
customNotice.body: If you need something not in our catalog, we build it from scratch. Request a quote and we'll come back with scope, timeline and proposal within 48 business hours.
